newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge higher to end at 19.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge higher to end at 19.75 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates firmed on Wednesday as some banks showed buying interest before the end of the current reserve period on Thursday.
Overnight rates opened between 19.25 to 19.75 percent compared with Tuesday's 19.50-percent close but later firmed to 19.75 percent.
"The firming is probably some banks replenishing their reserves before the end of the month," said Gabor Liener of Unicbank.
ING Bank's Csaba Thaly said the rates could rise further on Thursday depending on banks' demand.
"They won't necessarily go up much," he said. "It depends on the state of banks' reserves."
Hungary's overnight rates tend to hover around the central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo rate, currently at 20.00 percent.
